messages:
Ellen: quick UX review on Compliance > Storage & Keys — attaching a screenshot.
Marco: saw it, a couple quick thoughts.
Riya: main issues? short list pls.
Ellen: 1) retention control is below region selector on mobile and gets cut off. 2) KMS label reads 'Customer key' which some customers read as 'we store it'.
Theo: agree re KMS wording. maybe 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' with a short helper.
Riya: +1. also accessibility: the KMS badge icon has low contrast against the chip background.
ux-bot: a11y check: icon contrast ratio 2.5:1 (fail). Recommend darker icon or include text label.
Marco: audit log event names are raw (e.g., `kms.rotate`)  can we map to friendly text in the table?
Ellen: yes show human text like 'Key rotated' and put `kms.rotate` in the expanded payload view.
Theo: keyboard order nit: current tab sequence is toggle -> KMS -> retention -> region. We should reorder to toggle -> region -> retention -> KMS.
Riya: copy tweak for retention label: 'Auto-delete after' feels clearer than 'Retention (days)'. Also modal confirm should say 'This action is permanent' not just 'Are you sure?'.
Marco: will update mock and push a tiny PR. tagging @Riya @Theo for copy/a11y review.
Ellen: thanks all
